key_reasoning.reason: Touches three distinct components across the full OTLP pipeline: the CLI connector that writes Claude Code's exporter env vars (claude-code-otlp.ts, protocol switched to http/json plus OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS), the proxy ingestion handler (otlp.plugin.ts, new handleOtlpJson branch alongside the existing byte-blind handleOtlpBinary path), and the otlp-spool subsystem (spool-paths.ts, spool-io.ts, spool-state.ts, session-status.ts, tick-processor.ts, forwarder.ts) extended with a parallel OtelJsonStream type, new PendingNdjsonBatch/snapshotPendingNdjsonRecords abstractions, and a forwardOtelJsonStream path.

No exact precedent existed for masking native OTEL telemetry (only hook events were masked previously, per the prior commit 54e24e7); the fix reuses the existing maskSecretsDeep utility directly in handleOtlpJson, which is standard, but the work is explicitly security-sensitive (EPMCDME-16383, secrets leaking into analytics attrs) and required a coordinated protocol switch (protobuf to http/json) across the CLI connector, proxy ingestion, spool format, and forwarder content-type.

15 files changed total per diffstat (14 modified, 1 new test file: otlp.plugin.otel-json.test.ts), spanning src/cli/commands/proxy/connectors/ and the otlp-spool subsystem under src/providers/plugins/sso/proxy/plugins/ — maps to the 11-15 file band (XL).

Four layers touched: Infrastructure/CLI (claude-code-otlp.ts env config), Service/API (otlp.plugin.ts request handling), DB-Persistence (otlp-spool file format extended with new logsJson/metricsJson/tracesJson streams and cursor fields), and External (forwarder.ts posting application/json to the analytics backend) — matches the L criteria of 3-4 layers including persistence.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): the change is explicitly a security fix (masking secrets in forwarded OTLP telemetry) with no prior precedent for the native-OTEL-JSON path in this codebase.
